11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager wakes with the peculiar feeling that something unusual is going to happen.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) wakes with the peculiar feeling that something unusual is going to happen. (He/She) cannot explain why. The sky is clear, the village is peaceful, and nothing seems out of place. Still, the feeling persists.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) spends the day observing everything carefully. A bird steals a piece of fruit. Two villagers argue about a basket. A coconut falls from a tree. None seems particularly mysterious. By evening (name1) is tired of looking for signs.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (name1) works, eats, talks with friends, and enjoys the afternoon breeze. Nothing extraordinary happens. Before bed (he/she) remembers the strange feeling and shrugs. Perhaps tomorrow will be more interesting.
